# UI SDK browser components

Selected browser modules from `@ui-sdk/web@0.1.0-beta.2`, distributed under
Apache-2.0. See [LICENSE](LICENSE) and the [upstream project](https://github.com/vercel-labs/ui).

The application loads Select, Command, Dialog and Drawer from local component entries.
Keep their shared chunks together. Application styles are in `ui-workspace.css`
and `workspace-system.css`; the optional upstream global theme is not loaded.
